newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Bomb blast kills one man in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Bomb blast kills one man in Karachi.

text.p: A bomb blew up in a video shop in the southern Pakistani port city of Karachi on Wednesday, killing a man and injuring two others, police said.
There was no immediate information about who set off the bomb in a crowded market in southern Karachi.
Police said they had registered a case and were investigating.
More than 2,500 people, including 300 security officials, have died in politicla and ethnic violence in Karachi since 1995.
However, the city has remained comparatively calm for the past several months.
